footnotes.fn_2a8cdc51: The number of refugee returns to Ukraine is estimated using IOM’s "Returns Report — General Population Survey" and "Internal Displacement Report — General Population Survey", Round 19. The breakdown by former country of asylum is based on results from the latest UNHCR Intention Surveys with refugees returnees.
